reusable_components.established: Validation, expected-current CAS, immutable snapshot staging, atomic pointer, rollback, publication receipt exist.
reusable_components.gap: Local filesystem API; CAS is concurrency control, receipt is digest-derived and no distinct publisher principal or Phase2 CI receipt is required. Direct file/Git modifications are outside this function.
Explicit test_generation, production=false, published=false, authority_effect=NONE; cannot relabel as production release enforcement.

lowest_cost_existing_path_candidate.path: Extend the existing trusted gate-receipt plus publisher activation path, without new Worker/Binding/service.
required_small_changes: Pin verifier and policy identity outside the candidate it validates; bind actual CI workflow identity and digest, run/attempt, candidate commit, artifact digest, registry/manifest digests and fresh acceptance/freeze references. Do not accept a same-named check or a candidate-supplied receipt as authority.

Require that binding at the existing formal activation entry; reuse expected-current CAS and rollback. Keep all unrelated code pushes as non-authoritative candidates only where consumers actually enforce that distinction.

Verify existing publisher credential/storage/deploy permissions already separate ordinary contributors from activation. If absent, a wrapper is still optional and this route remains pending; do not assert that all administrators or all actors are merely contributors.
Keep exact admin exception identity/action/evidence auditable. Do not label an ordinary contributor bypass an admin exception.
necessary_negative_cases: Skip local script/workflow, then attempt actual governed activation.
Modify Registry/Manifest/CI verifier or create a same-named green check; prove rejected by a trusted activation path.
Reuse old receipt or another candidate PASS; prove rejection before state changes.
Attempt direct pointer/alternate publish path with ordinary contributor capability; verify no authoritative activation, or document that this path is still open.
not_claimed: No GitHub merge non-bypass without native protection.
No requirement to upgrade or make public.
No new control plane, production Worker or Binding design.
No reduction of the fixed acceptance scope based only on cost.

enforcement_boundary_audit.decision_rule: Prefer the existing publisher route only if real privilege isolation and mandatory activation binding can be shown with small bounded work. Otherwise leave only Step15/18 enforcement pending and continue independent prerequisites; do not buy Pro or build a new platform without authorization.
